gloss: nursing care leave; family care leave

definitions.gloss: nursing care leave; family care leave
definitions.explanation: leave from work to care for a family member who needs nursing care

examples.japanese: ⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{介護|かいご}→介護：04805_kaigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{介護休暇|かいごきゅうか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: I took nursing care leave to care for my parent.

examples.japanese: {介護休暇|かいごきゅうか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{年間|ねんかん}→年間：00974_nenkan⟧5⟦{日|にち}→日：12732_nichi⟧⟦{取得|しゅとく}できる→取得する：10444_shutokusuru⟧。
examples.english: You can take 5 days of nursing care leave per year.

examples.japanese: {介護休暇|かいごきゅうか}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{介護休業|かいごきゅうぎょう}→介護休業：23751_kaigokyuugyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧だ。
examples.english: Short-term care leave and long-term care leave are separate systems.

notes:
SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{介護休業|かいごきゅうぎょう}→介護休業：23751_kaigokyuugyou⟧ - long-term care leave: up to 93 days in total per family member, which can be split into three blocks. {介護休暇|かいごきゅうか} is the short one: up to 5 days a year per family member (10 for two or more), taken by the day or by the hour.

CULTURAL NOTE:
As Japan's population ages, {介護離職|かいごりしょく} (quitting a job to care for a family member) has become a recognized social problem; both kinds of leave exist to prevent it.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{介護|かいご}→介護：04805_kaigo⟧ - nursing care
- ⟦{育休|いくきゅう}→育休：08565_ikukyuu⟧ - childcare leave
